tailMarker.note: Parfum @9 is the earliest tail-class species (Potassium Sorbate @10, Benzyl Alcohol @17, MCI @20, MI @24 follow; no declared allergens, no booster, no chelator). E13: every species establishing conditioning_level/weight_potential outranks it (Cetyl Alcohol @2, Cetrimonium Chloride @3, Paraffinum Liquidum @4, Cetearyl Ethylhexanoate @5, Stearyl Alcohol @6, Argan @7). Third limb: no allergen above Parfum, no booster/chelator ordering involving the marker — consistent. Aqueous O/W emulsion, so the low-water limb does not apply. Below-marker extras (Cetrimonium Bromide @14, Isopropyl Myristate @12, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride @23) cannot make it implausible (E13).

conditioning_level.rationale: Above Parfum @9 the list runs a single long-chain cationic (Cetrimonium Chloride @3), so S1 fails and `high` is unavailable. S2 holds (Cetyl Alcohol @2) and S3 holds (Paraffinum Liquidum @4, Cetearyl Ethylhexanoate @5, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil @7), giving S2+S3 without S1 = `moderate`. The second cationic Cetrimonium Bromide @14 sits below the plausible marker: it earns nothing, but crediting it would complete S1 and lift the value to `high`, so it fires candidate_below_tail and review (E13).
evidenceSignals: S3: Paraffinum Liquidum @4, Cetearyl Ethylhexanoate @5, Argan @7
R1 base: Cetrimonium Chloride @3 + Cetyl @2 / Stearyl @6
counterSignals: S1 fails above the marker (one cationic)
candidate_below_tail: Cetrimonium Bromide @14 would have completed S1

weight_potential.rationale: Paraffinum Liquidum @4 is an occlusive hydrocarbon, named by §5 R4's mask delta and E14's R4b band as heavy, so it forms the heavy-lipid core above the marker; Argan @7 is mid band and contributes nothing toward `high` (E14). The core is completed by a dense fatty-alcohol base — Cetyl Alcohol @2 and Stearyl Alcohol @6 (two distinct fatty alcohols above the tail, one in the top three). No positioning claims lightness and tail_index − 1 (Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate @8, an emulsifier) is not load-bearing; confidence is held at `moderate` because the lexicon files Paraffinum Liquidum under 'hydrocarbons' with a light/weight-neutral band, so the sole R4b core species carries a band-membership tension between the standard and the lexicon.
evidenceSignals: dense fatty base: Cetyl Alcohol @2 + Stearyl Alcohol @6
mid band: Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil @7 (blocks low only)
counterSignals: lexicon family 3 lists Paraffinum Liquidum among hydrocarbons and names 'light hydrocarbons' weight-neutral; the standard (§5 R4, §9.2) governs and names it heavy
Cetearyl Ethylhexanoate @5 is R4a (no weight signal)

care_direction.rationale: No R5 protein, peptide or keratin species at any rank, so `protein` and `balanced` (a) are unavailable; no silicone or cationic-polymer film exists, so reading (b) clause 2 fails. The cetyl/stearyl/cetrimonium base with a mineral-oil, ester and argan emollient leg above Parfum @9 is the coherent non-protein `moisture` direction. The marker is plausible and the route separation is unambiguous.
evidenceSignals: emollient leg Paraffinum Liquidum @4, Cetearyl Ethylhexanoate @5, Argan @7
counterSignals: humectants only in the tail (Triethylene Glycol @16, Propylene Glycol @19) — subordinate, no direction

repair_support_level.rationale: No qualifying R5 species and no bond-chemistry token anywhere on the list; Niacinamide @13 and the antioxidant vitamins are tail tokens with zero credit (lexicon 5c). Only ordinary R1/R4 conditioning is present, which §9.4 reads as `low`.

primary_focus.rationale: Step 3 routes (repair, curl_support, color_care) have no formula candidate. Step 4 fails at criterion 1 (no humectant above Parfum @9); step 5 fails criterion 1 (no silicone or polymer optical route). The mineral-oil/argan/ester lipid load is the rich M1 base that step 1 and §6 rule 1 exclude as a distinctive smoothing route, so the verdict is `nonspecific` → `general`; the 'Arganöl' name is positioning only.

secondary_focus.rationale: No independent second route clears: no humectant cluster for a moisture slot, no optical architecture for shine, and the lipid film is already the M1 base. Adding smoothing would reuse the primary's shared mechanism (§6).

fired.note: A second long-chain cationic at or below the plausible marker; credited above-tail it would complete S1 and move conditioning_level moderate → high (S1+S2). It earns nothing and caps nothing; a human weighs whether the tail order hides real architecture.
